## What are you adding or changing?

<!-- One or two sentences. If you are adding links, just list them. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Every entry has a description saying **what it is and why someone would open it**
- [ ] Links resolve (no 404s, no redirects to a homepage)
- [ ] Entry is placed in the section a reader would look in first, and follows the existing order
- [ ] Not already in the list (search the README first — the same URL should appear only once)
- [ ] Paywalled, registration-required, or proprietary resources are labeled as such
- [ ] Archived or unmaintained projects are marked as archived rather than listed as if current

## Why does this clear the bar?

<!--
